purpose: A visual keyboard-key label with native kbd semantics.

component: Render a kbd element with supplied content and ordinary kbd properties. Merge className and expose size for presentation.
Do not register keyboard listeners or synthesize shortcut behavior.
host: Show shortcuts that actually exist in the current platform/context and provide readable key names.
Own keyboard bindings, conflicts, localization and accessible action descriptions.

requirements.statement: Render a kbd element with supplied content and ordinary kbd properties. Merge className and expose size for presentation.
Do not register keyboard listeners or synthesize shortcut behavior.
Show shortcuts that actually exist in the current platform/context and provide readable key names.
Own keyboard bindings, conflicts, localization and accessible action descriptions.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Displayed shortcut text does not bind a command.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
